name: Sto 120x50 (eating table, NW corner)
comment: Small eating table for two against the west wall in the NW corner of the Ljilja boravak. Top 1200 x 500 x 28 at 750, placed with rot 90 so the long side runs along the west wall. Four 50 x 50 legs inset 40 from the edges; the two chairs stand on the long east side facing the wall, backs to the room, like the l2-39 dining set.
